The electrical upgrade for 16 workstations and the additional network drops would fall within that restriction, so the grant funds should be able to cover those infrastructure costs. However, I do need to get this entered into the project ledger promptly so we have a clear record of the available funding as the scope of the electrical and network upgrades is revised. I'd also note that once Mr. Ortiz and Ms. Shah revise their assessments for 16 workstations, we should confirm whether the total infrastructure costs remain within the $18,500 before Dr. Morgan issues final approval.

commitments.detail: Revise the conversion request to include the dedicated 240-volt circuit requirement sized for 16 workstations.
Update the network field in the conversion request to document the district-secure IoT network with wired drops for 16 workstations.
Enter the $18,500 workforce-development grant into the project ledger and confirm that revised infrastructure costs for 16 workstations remain within the grant restriction.
Update the workstation count in the conversion request from 12 to 16 to align with the confirmed enrollment roster.

Final approval is conditional on all documentation updates being completed and verified, and on confirmation that total infrastructure costs remain within the $18,500 grant before equipment delivery proceeds.
